name: image-tools
description: Let Claude see and edit images, including ones you paste: zoom, pixel grids, crop, resize, rotate, adjust and convert.
long_description: Gives Claude tools to inspect image files on your computer in more detail than a downscaled preview allows (zoom into regions at full resolution, split large images into tiles, overlay a pixel-coordinate grid) and to edit them: crop, resize (fit, fill, pad, stretch), rotate and flip, adjust brightness and contrast, and convert between PNG, JPEG, WebP, HEIC, AVIF, GIF, TIFF, BMP, ICO and PDF. Originals are never modified; results are saved next to the source file.

tools.name: image_info
tools.description: Dimensions, format, color mode, file size and key EXIF data

tools.name: view_image
tools.description: Show any image file, including HEIC, TIFF, AVIF and BMP

tools.name: find_images
tools.description: Find recent images and chat attachments as numbered thumbnails

tools.name: grid_overlay
tools.description: Overlay a labeled pixel-coordinate grid for precise cropping

tools.name: zoom_image
tools.description: Inspect a region at full resolution to read small text and detail

tools.name: split_tiles
tools.description: Split a large image into overlapping tiles shown at full detail

tools.name: crop_image
tools.description: Crop to a pixel or fractional box and save

tools.name: resize_image
tools.description: Resize by scale or dimensions with fit, fill, pad or stretch

tools.name: rotate_flip_image
tools.description: Rotate by any angle and/or mirror

tools.name: adjust_image
tools.description: Brightness, contrast, sharpness, saturation, autocontrast, grayscale

tools.name: convert_image
tools.description: Convert between PNG, JPEG, WebP, HEIC, AVIF, GIF, TIFF, BMP, ICO and PDF

tools.name: copy_to_clipboard
tools.description: Put an image on the clipboard to paste anywhere

output_dir.title: Output folder
output_dir.description: Where edited copies of pasted or clipboard images are saved.
